name: Sleepless Night 2: Ladies' Night(mare)
source: Another Sleepless Night! However, this time you are going to spend the night at a friend's house where no boys are allowed. Natsumi, Midori, and Shizuka are having a Ladies' Night at Shizuka's house and you are invited. You can explore the whole house and collect clues. But don't get yourself killed! There are dangers lurking everywhere.
translation: 又是一个不眠之夜！然而，这次你要在朋友家过夜，那里不允许男孩入住。夏美、绿和静香正在静香家里举办女士之夜，你受到了邀请。你可以探索整个房子并收集线索。但别把自己弄死了！到处都潜伏着危险。
